title: CmdPal dock title and subtitle visibility resets after settings changes
author: michaeljolley
summary: A Command Palette dock item's hidden title or subtitle is restored after an unrelated settings change; the issue is assigned to its reporter and fixed by linked upstream PR #50363.

judgment.rationale: The issue is explicitly fixed by the open upstream PR #50363. Its description identifies the same new-dock-band visibility persistence failure and its changed files include the dock view models plus targeted persistence tests.
evidence: The report provides a clear four-step reproduction sequence and states that title and subtitle visibility choices are not persisted.
The issue is assigned to michaeljolley.
Visible issue timeline activity cross-references upstream PR #50363.
PR #50363 states "Fixes #50361" and describes carrying pending title and subtitle visibility into the final settings merge for newly added dock bands.
PR #50363 modifies DockBandViewModel.cs and DockViewModel.cs and adds DockLabelPersistenceTests.cs.
judgment.recommended_action: Track and validate the linked upstream PR rather than creating a competing investigation or fix proposal.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open upstream PR #50363 directly references and implements the reported persistence scenario, with focused unit-test coverage.

issue_context.summary: Changing an unrelated Command Palette setting causes a new dock item's title and subtitle visibility settings to revert.
known_information: The report targets a current Command Palette development build used from Visual Studio.
It provides explicit steps involving a new dock item, the hide-title or hide-subtitle context-menu choice, an unrelated setting change, and returning to the dock.
The issue has no comments and is assigned to michaeljolley.
Open upstream PR #50363 declares that it fixes this issue and adds dock-label persistence tests.
inferences: The failure is consistent with pending visibility state being lost during the merge of newly added dock-band settings.
The linked PR's stated behavior and focused changed files indicate it covers the reported path, subject to normal PR review and validation.
issue_context.analysis: The linked implementation removes the need for separate dashboard design work. Maintaining one fix path avoids duplicate changes while retaining the issue's report and testable reproduction as validation context for PR #50363.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body, labels, assignee, comments, and visible timeline references.
Read PR #50363 metadata and changed-file list; it is open and directly references #50361.
Confirmed that the PR changes the two Command Palette dock view models and adds DockLabelPersistenceTests.cs.
